answer: WITH ms AS ( SELECT m.zoneref, count(*) AS total_meshes, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::float8 / ((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::float8 * power((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::float8, 2)) * 1000) > 5.0 AND (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::float8 < 1.0 AND (m.mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::float8 < 0.5)) AS hf_meshes, avg(((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::float8 / ((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::float8 * power((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::float8, 2)) * 1000)) AS avg_mcr, avg((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::float8) AS avg_res, avg((m.mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::float8) AS avg_geom FROM mesh m GROUP BY m.zoneref) SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, si.zonelabel AS site_name, COALESCE(ms.total_meshes,0) AS total_meshes, COALESCE(ms.hf_meshes,0) AS high_fidelity_meshes, ROUND(COALESCE(ms.hf_meshes*100.0/NULLIF(ms.total_meshes,0),0)::numeric,2) AS high_fidelity_percentage, ROUND(ms.avg_mcr::numeric,2) AS avg_mcr, ROUND(ms.avg_res::numeric,2) AS avg_resolution_mm, ROUND(ms.avg_geom::numeric,2) AS avg_geometric_accuracy, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ms.hf_meshes,0) > 0 THEN 'Has High-Fidelity Meshes' WHEN ms.total_meshes > 0 THEN 'Standard Mesh Quality' ELSE 'No Mesh Data' END AS mesh_quality_classification FROM sites si LEFT JOIN ms ON ms.zoneref = si.zoneregistry ORDER BY high_fidelity_percentage DESC, site_code

SELECT r.logregistry AS registration_id, r.arcref AS project_id, (r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::float8 AS registration_accuracy_mm, (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::float8 AS error_value_mm, ROUND(((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::float8 / ((r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::float8 * sqrt(1 + (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::float8/(r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::float8)))::numeric,2) AS rar, CASE WHEN ((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::float8 / ((r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::float8 * sqrt(1 + (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::float8/(r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::float8))) > 1.5 AND r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Method' LIKE '%Target%' THEN 'High Confidence' WHEN ((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::float8 / ((r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::float8 * sqrt(1 + (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::float8/(r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::float8))) BETWEEN 1.0 AND 1.5 THEN 'Medium Confidence' ELSE 'Low Confidence' END AS confidence_level FROM registration r JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = r.arcref AND pc.crewref = r.crewref ORDER BY rar DESC, registration_id

SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, si.zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(avg((100 - 2.5*abs((e.ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::float8 - 20) - power(abs(((e.ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::float8 - 50)/2), 1.5) - 600/((e.ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::float8 + 100)))::numeric,2) AS avg_esi FROM sites si JOIN environment e ON e.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel ORDER BY avg_esi DESC, site_code

SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, si.zonelabel AS site_name, c.structstate AS structural_state, si.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' AS preservation_status, 'Degradation Risk Zone' AS risk_zone_category FROM sites si JOIN conservation c ON c.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE si.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' ~ '(Poor|Critical)' AND c.structstate NOT LIKE '%Stable%'

SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, si.zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(avg((0.3*((power(10/(log((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::float8*1000) / log((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::float8) * 5), 1.5) * (((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::float8 * (1 + (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::float8/100 * (1 - (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::float8/100)))/100) * power(1 - (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::float8/30, 2))*0.4 + (((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::float8 / ((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::float8 * power((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::float8, 2)) * 1000) * (((m.mesh_specs->>'Tex_Pix')::float8 / (sqrt((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::float8) * (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::float8) * 0.01)/10) * (1 + exp(-(m.mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::float8)))*0.4 + ((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::float8 * (1 + (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::float8/100 * (1 - (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::float8/100)))*0.2 - 5*sqrt((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::float8/10)) + 0.3*(((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::float8 / ((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::float8 * power((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::float8, 2)) * 1000) * (((m.mesh_specs->>'Tex_Pix')::float8 / (sqrt((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::float8) * (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::float8) * 0.01)/10) * (1 + exp(-(m.mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::float8))) + 0.2*((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::float8 / ((r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::float8 * sqrt(1 + (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::float8/(r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::float8))) + 0.2*((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::float8 * (1 + (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::float8/100 * (1 - (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::float8/100))) - 2*sqrt((r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::float8/(pc.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::float8)))::numeric,2) AS dpq FROM sites si JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = s.arcref AND pc.crewref = s.crewref JOIN mesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneref JOIN registration r ON r.arcref = s.arcref AND r.crewref = s.crewref GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel ORDER BY dpq DESC, site_code

WITH p AS ( SELECT s.zoneref, avg(((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::float8 / ((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::float8 * (sp.spatial_dims->>'Area_M2')::float8))) AS avg_pcdr FROM scans s JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = s.arcref AND pc.crewref = s.crewref JOIN spatial sp ON sp.arcref = s.arcref AND sp.crewref = s.crewref GROUP BY s.zoneref), fe AS ( SELECT s.zoneref, avg((((f.feature_analysis->>'Trait_Count')::float8 + (f.feature_analysis->>'Arti_Count')::float8) / (((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::float8 / ((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::float8 * (sp.spatial_dims->>'Area_M2')::float8)) * sqrt((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::float8)) * 1000)) AS avg_fee FROM scans s JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = s.arcref AND pc.crewref = s.crewref JOIN spatial sp ON sp.arcref = s.arcref AND sp.crewref = s.crewref JOIN features f ON f.zoneref = s.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneref) SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, ROUND(p.avg_pcdr::numeric,2) AS avg_pcdr, ROUND(fe.avg_fee::numeric,2) AS avg_fee FROM sites si LEFT JOIN p ON p.zoneref = si.zoneregistry LEFT JOIN fe ON fe.zoneref = si.zoneregistry ORDER BY avg_fee DESC NULLS LAST, site_code

WITH w AS ( SELECT pr.flowregistry, (CASE WHEN lower(pr.flowsoft) LIKE 'agi%' OR lower(pr.flowsoft)='metashape' THEN 'Agisoft' WHEN lower(replace(pr.flowsoft,' ','')) IN ('cloudcompare','cc','c.c.') THEN 'CloudCompare' WHEN lower(pr.flowsoft) LIKE 'geo%' THEN 'Geomagic' WHEN lower(replace(pr.flowsoft,' ','')) IN ('realitycapture','rc','r.c.') THEN 'RealityCapture' ELSE pr.flowsoft END) AS software, pr.flowstage AS stage, (pr.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::float8 AS hrs, (pr.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::float8 AS cpu, (pr.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::float8 AS gpu, split_part(s.size,' ',1)::float8 AS size_gb, (split_part(s.size,' ',1)::float8 * log((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::float8) / ((pr.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::float8 * ((pr.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::float8 + (pr.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::float8)/200)) AS per FROM processing pr JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = pr.zoneref JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = s.arcref AND pc.crewref = s.crewref), g AS ( SELECT software, stage, avg(hrs) AS avg_hrs, avg(cpu) AS avg_cpu, avg(gpu) AS avg_gpu, avg(size_gb) AS avg_size, avg(per) AS avg_per, count(DISTINCT flowregistry) AS workflow_count FROM w GROUP BY software, stage) SELECT software, stage, ROUND(avg_hrs::numeric,1) AS avg_processing_hours, ROUND(avg_cpu::numeric,1) AS avg_cpu_usage_pct, ROUND(avg_gpu::numeric,1) AS avg_gpu_usage_pct, ROUND(avg_size::numeric,1) AS avg_data_size_gb, ROUND(avg_per::numeric,1) AS avg_per, CASE WHEN avg_per < 0.5 THEN 'Bottleneck Detected' ELSE 'Efficient' END AS efficiency_status, workflow_count FROM g ORDER BY CASE WHEN avg_per < 0.5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, avg_per ASC

WITH x AS ( SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, si.zonelabel AS site_name, avg((e.ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::float8) AS avg_temp, avg((e.ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::float8) AS avg_hum, avg((e.ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::float8) AS avg_lux, avg((100 - 2.5*abs((e.ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::float8 - 20) - power(abs(((e.ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::float8 - 50)/2), 1.5) - 600/((e.ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::float8 + 100))) AS avg_esi FROM sites si JOIN environment e ON e.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel) SELECT site_code, site_name, ROUND(avg_temp::numeric,1) AS avg_temperature, ROUND(avg_hum::numeric,1) AS avg_humidity, ROUND(avg_lux::numeric,1) AS avg_illumination, ROUND(avg_esi::numeric,1) AS avg_esi, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY avg_esi) AS esi_quartile, CASE WHEN avg_esi > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions' WHEN avg_esi >= 70 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions' WHEN avg_esi >= 50 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions' ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions' END AS environmental_condition FROM x ORDER BY avg_esi DESC, site_code

SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, si.zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(avg((power(10/(log((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::float8*1000) / log((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::float8) * 5), 1.5) * (((pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::float8 * (1 + (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::float8/100 * (1 - (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::float8/100)))/100) * power(1 - (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::float8/30, 2)))::numeric,2) AS avg_sqs FROM sites si JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = s.arcref AND pc.crewref = s.crewref GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel ORDER BY avg_sqs DESC, site_code

WITH w AS ( SELECT pr.equipref, pr.flowregistry, ((pr.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::float8 * ((pr.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::float8 + (pr.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::float8) / 2 / (split_part(s.size,' ',1)::float8 * 10 * log((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::float8 + 1e4))) AS pru, (pr.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::float8 AS hrs, (pr.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::float8 AS cpu, (pr.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::float8 AS gpu FROM processing pr JOIN mesh m ON m.zoneref = pr.zoneref AND m.equipref = pr.equipref JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = pr.zoneref), g AS ( SELECT eq.equipregistry AS equipment_id, avg(w.pru) AS pru, avg(w.hrs) AS avg_hrs, avg(w.cpu) AS avg_cpu, avg(w.gpu) AS avg_gpu FROM equipment eq LEFT JOIN w ON w.equipref = eq.equipregistry GROUP BY eq.equipregistry) SELECT equipment_id, ROUND(pru::numeric,2) AS pru, ROUND(avg_hrs::numeric,2) AS avg_processing_hours, CASE WHEN pru IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pru ASC NULLS LAST) END AS efficiency_rank, CASE WHEN pru IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN pru < 5.0 THEN 'Optimized' WHEN pru <= 10.0 THEN 'Acceptable' ELSE 'Needs Optimization' END AS workflow_efficiency_status, json_build_object('cpu_usage', ROUND(avg_cpu::numeric,2), 'gpu_usage', ROUND(avg_gpu::numeric,2), 'processing_hours', ROUND(avg_hrs::numeric,2)) AS resource_details FROM g ORDER BY pru ASC NULLS LAST, equipment_id
